from pathlib import Path

assert 'DROP TABLE' in text.upper()

print('bytes', Path('$DST').stat().st_size)
print('file:', __import__('subprocess').check_output(['file','$DST']).decode().strip())
# show first/last non-empty lines

print('first:', lines[0][:80])
print('has_drop:', any(l.strip().upper().startswith('DROP') for l in lines))
